AtTheRequestOf: (at the request of Governor Kate Brown)
CatchLine: Expands availability of elective reduced personal income tax rate for certain pass-through income to taxpayers doing business as sole proprietors.
MeasureSummary:
Expands availability of elective reduced personal income tax rate for certain pass-through income to taxpayers doing business as sole proprietors. 
	Applies to tax years beginning on or after January 1, 2018. 
	Takes effect on 91st day following adjournment sine die.
RelatingTo: Relating to material participation in a business; prescribing an effective date.
RelatingToFull: Relating to material participation in a business; creating new provisions; amending ORS 316.043; and prescribing an effective date.

CatchLine: Adjourns sine die 2018 special session of Seventy-ninth Legislative Assembly.
MeasureSummary: Adjourns sine die 2018 special session of Seventy-ninth Legislative Assembly.
RelatingTo: Adjourning sine die the 2018 special session of the Seventy-ninth Legislative Assembly.
